display_name: Elvish (the Vaneth, three branches of one people)
_note: The elvish tier: one people (the Vaneth) in three branches descended from a shared Proto-Elvish tongue, VANETHIR ('the Old Speech'). DESIGN: every human pantheon-name is a morph of one 25-power canon, so the human families already share consonant SKELETONS (Tulrius = Thulr/Toran/Tulor/Tolratl/Tulax/Tulrios/Tulrish, all T-L-R). Those skeletons ARE the Vanethir root-stock. Each elvish branch applies a consistent sound-law to the proto-roots (consonants preserved; vowels/endings/allophones shift) and is tuned to the phonology of the human cluster it is the deep ancestor of - so cognates are recognizable across the three branches AND each branch prefigures its human descendants. AESTHETIC: Aelvaneth and Thalvaneth render the roots SMOOTH and lilting (the high-elf trope; soft -ath/-ash/-eth, l/r/n/th); Xilvaneth renders them HARSH and guttural (the dark-elf stand-in; glottal k'/t', tz, x, -tl). Demihuman tier (race elf): golden-age->enclave arc, alignment weights per branch (catalog 5.2). DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real gods; the Vanethir forms are framed in flavor as the eldest in the world, but the data-canon key stays Agrippan.
tier_note: demihuman; up to 3 elf seed points per campaign (catalog 5.2); end_state enclave.

aelvaneth.model: a deep PIE-like ancestor of the European IE human families

xilvaneth.model: a deep ancestor of the Mesoamerican families (Nahuatl/Maya); Andean/Quechua phonological tilt as flavor

thalvaneth.model: a deep Mediterranean ancestor of the Latinate/Hellenic and Punic families

branch_laws._note: Applied to the Proto-Elvish roots; the consonant SKELETON is preserved, so cognates stay recognizable across branches.
branch_laws.aelvaneth: SMOOTH: soft endings -ath/-ash/-eth/-a/-en/-el; voiced/aspirate softening (no harsh -az); ablaut e/o; flowing l/r/n/th; lilting open syllables.
branch_laws.xilvaneth: HARSH: glottalization k'/t'/p'; the affricate tz and x (sh); incipient -tl/-' endings; vowels reduce toward a/i/u; clipped, guttural.
branch_laws.thalvaneth: SMOOTH (Mediterranean): vowel-rich endings -os/-a/-e/-eth; sibilants s/sh; a light guttural/pharyngeal touch (the Punic descendant); flowing.

theonym_set._note: The 25-power canon as Proto-Elvish skeletons, each with the three branch reflexes. Read across a row = obvious cognates; read past the reflex = the human descendants each branch prefigures. Representative set (the build assembles the full 25).

proto_roots._note: Proto-Elvish core-concept roots (skeleton) with the three branch reflexes; realized per culture's lexicon. Cognate across branches.

title_skeleton._note: ACKS 7 tiers; one proto ladder, three branch reflexes. Elven realms are ancient (golden-age kingdoms now mostly fallen to enclaves); civ government.
government_modeled: feudal (all three elvish branches are ancient civ realms)

elf_canon.lifecycle: high peak_strength, high collapse_proneness, end_state enclave (golden age -> hard collapse to fastness-enclaves).
elf_canon.seed_biomes: Aelvaneth forest+river; Xilvaneth jungle+river; Thalvaneth coastal/sea+isle.
elf_canon.conquest: in-biome genocide, out-of-biome vassalize, always-genocide vs other demihumans (catalog 5.2).

conventions.people_name_default: given name from the branch root-stock + a lineage (the elven houses, -iel/-ion-style soft for Ael/Thal, -tl/-' for Xil); the smooth branches lilting, Xilvaneth clipped and harsh.
settlement_named_after: the branch's realized roots: star/tree/sea/river + -aneth/-anar realm-suffix
conventions.transparent_vs_opaque: moderate; the roots are transparent across branches once the laws are known.
